## Completion criteria

- [ ] The end-to-end user workflow is documented.
- [ ] API and UI behavior are implemented together where applicable.
- [ ] Failure, empty, loading, and authorization states are covered.
- [ ] Unit and integration regression tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend production build passes.
- [ ] Security, data, and operational implications are documented.
- [ ] Demo evidence and README are updated without overstating deployment readiness.
